description: GPO policy to Intune setting mappings, imported from manual mapping workbooks by Import-IntuneMappingWorkbook.ps1. Compare-GPOXml.ps1 and Compare-GPOHtml.ps1 match a setting by class + policy name (case and spacing ignored). Status Mapped: intuneSetting / intuneSubSetting is the Intune equivalent. Status NoIntuneEquivalent: reviewed in a workbook, no Intune setting. alternates: other mappings given for the same policy in other workbooks. scrubbed = true: identifying details are replaced with placeholders and remarks are not included.
